entities.summary: The Saudi Central Bank, established in 1952 and known until 2020 as the Saudi Arabian Monetary Authority, is the central bank of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Despite the 2020 name change, the Saudi Central Bank has continued to use the same acronym SAMA.
